parts:
Tom

I often struggle with creation of the coverage grid.  It is an iterative process to get the spacing correct such that I have on the order of 500-1000 points in my study area to examine evenness of design coverage.

I suspect a units problem.  Distance may be under the impression that the units of the shapefile are "m" rather than "km"; hence with 100m spacing, no points fall inside the study area.

Experiment with reducing the spacing (if my hypothesis is correct, you might choose to set the spacing to 0.1m) and let Distance tell you how many points fall within the study area--if it is a ridiculously large number, then throw that spacing away and use a larger value).


On 17/11/2017 15:03, tjbr...@gmail.com wrote:
Hi all,

I am trying to design a line transect survey across a protected area. I have successfully imported my shape file into Distance. However, when I try to project the coverage map by 'Create new data layer...' I get an error saying that '0' of my points fall into the survey area. The shape file for the survey covers 5,000 km squared, distance between grid points is set to 100m and I'm struggling to work out why this isn't working. Any pointers would be greatly received. 

Thanks for your time.

Tom Bruce
